## Expansion interface

Expansion represents string manipulation in a `ParamExp` other than those covered by `Replace`<!-- -->.

Auxiliary syntax data, not a syntax.Node; it has no independent source bounds.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface Expansion 
```
